scope: Bounded static audit of original Image CAP1188 probe/poll/transport/reset/remove paths; not complete firmware reconstruction

transport.raw_read: Two separate spi_sync calls: transmit one opcode, then receive one byte

input.multiple_changed_channels: State loop updates all channels, but audited reporting path emits only last changed channel plus SYN

reset.static_sequence: direction output 0, sleep 100ms, set 1, sleep 100ms, set 0

lifecycle.remove_callback: printk and return 0; static g_spi not cleared in audited remove
lifecycle.framework: Managed polled input allocation/registration includes unregister; closing polling synchronizes delayed work cancellation

reimplementation: Use official protocol and explicit identity/error gates; do not copy raw init pairs or claim original input registration validates a chip
